laws.rule: Yamagata City's anti-littering ordinance bans dropping cans, cigarette butts and other rubbish in public places, and leaving pet droppings. The city has set four 'no street smoking manner street' areas where walking while smoking is not allowed: the central shopping district, in front of City Hall and Buntokan, the east and west plazas of Yamagata Station, and Q1-mae-dori. The city's page lists no fine; the ordinance allows orders where the bans are broken.
